scope: Answer-local citation context, sibling citation navigation, and Back to chat return flow inside the verified PDF citation viewer.

checks.evidence: The viewer announces 'Answer-local citation context' and explicit anchor-quality text such as 'Near cited passage' instead of relying on visual position or color alone.
Sibling citations remain native buttons through the grounded citation affordance, stay keyboard reachable, and update the verified page/context without triggering a new authorization flow.
Back to chat is a keyboard-operable button that restores the source chat window, focuses the originating assistant message, scrolls it into view, and applies a transient visible highlight.
When the source chat window or rendered assistant message is unavailable, the control is marked aria-disabled and paired with explanatory text describing why return navigation is unavailable.
Return highlights use the governed focus ring plus optional reduced-motion-safe pulse and are removed automatically after the transient cleanup window so stale emphasis does not persist.

gate: Keyboard reachability, visible focus, non-color-only status messaging, disabled-state explanation, and transient highlight cleanup are covered by focused unit tests on the real viewer/session registry path.
